_comment: The push entry point of .github/workflows/run_on_mac.yaml. Editing this file and pushing launches a run on GitHub's Apple-silicon runner -- the way in for a branch whose workflow file has not reached master yet, where workflow_dispatch does not exist. Once it has, prefer the dispatch: it leaves no commit behind. See agent_guidance/gpu_harnesses.md. NOTE: the run step is `bash -e`, so chain diagnostic commands with `|| true` or the first non-zero exit takes the rest of the round with it.
command: uv run python benchmarks/_mps_render_smoke.py --verify-torch-ops || true; uv run python benchmarks/_mps_torch_op_probe.py || true; uv run python benchmarks/_mps_gloss_bounds_probe.py || true; uv run pytest -q -n 1 -rfEX --tb=line -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit_tests/test_mps_friendly.py tests/unit_tests/test_color_decode_boundary.py tests/unit_tests/test_viewer_fragments.py tests/unit_tests/test_glossy_prefilter.py tests/unit_tests/test_display_referred_coverage.py tests/unit_tests/test_deterministic_shadow_opacity.py || true
